name: Baasha
bio:
Baasha son of Ahijah, of the tribe of Issachar, conspired against King Nadab of Israel while Nadab and all Israel were besieging the Philistine town of Gibbethon. Baasha struck Nadab down and became king in his place, then exterminated the entire house of Jeroboam, leaving no survivors, exactly as the LORD had foretold through Ahijah the Shilonite because of Jeroboam's sins (1 Kings 15:27-30). Baasha reigned twenty-four years from Tirzah, yet he walked in the same sinful ways as Jeroboam, leading Israel into sin, and fought a continual war against Asa of Judah throughout his reign (1 Kings 15:16, 32-34).

The word of the LORD came against Baasha through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani: because Baasha had walked in Jeroboam's ways despite being raised up from nothing to lead Israel, the LORD would wipe out his house exactly as he had wiped out Jeroboam's, with his dead being eaten by dogs in the city and birds in the countryside (1 Kings 16:1-4). Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah succeeded him (1 Kings 16:6).
